name: sportcam
description: Subject-tracking robotic camera tripod — Firebase backend + companion app

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sportcam/backend" "npm run dev -w @sportcam/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sportcam/backend && npm run build -w @sportcam/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sportcam/functions && npm run typecheck -w @sportcam/web
